basics.name: Daniel Brandt
basics.label: Project Manager & Technology Lead
basics.summary:
Daniel's core competences consist of 20+ years of experience in developing Data & Analytics solutions. He has worked with cloud solutions for over 10 years, mainly with Microsoft solutions, and supports customers in their cloud transformations by designing solution architectures.

Daniel is deeply business-driven: whatever the data source, he focuses on translating it into valuable form — trusted, usable and decision-ready — so it can be used to grow the business and improve performance. He helps organizations combine data from sales, operations, core systems (ERP/CRM) and digital services to enable better steering, faster decisions and measurable outcomes. He enjoys co-designing solutions with business stakeholders, documenting clear information and technical architectures, and then bringing them to life with hands-on development. His core technical hands-on skill is building data platforms. Daniel is also continuously exploring how AI can enhance data quality and accelerate more reliable decision-making and smarter analytics solutions.

Daniel has been designing and implementing numerous projects for some of the largest companies in the Nordics in various roles.

projects.name: ERP program data team
projects.description:
Daniel was Data team lead in a large international ERP program. Daniel was supporting teams to deliver solution design documents and implementation for Azure Data Platform, Business Intelligence and Data migrations. The solution was based on Microsoft D365 and Azure.

Daniel worked as Project Manager for a Data Platform POC based on Microsoft Fabric. He worked as project manager for several Data Quality projects. He also worked as Data Architect for a Data Governance project and Solution Architect for a Sustainability data solution project based on Power Apps and Power BI. Daniel was a hands-on Technical architect for Data Migrations, including the D365 Finance & Operations data migration, and contributed to the Enterprise Data Platform technology selection.

projects.name: Data Engineering and Infrastructure development
projects.description: Daniel was a hands-on developer and architect in a digital solution project for environmental situation awareness. Daniel was responsible for data integrations and ETL work with Azure Data Factory and Azure SQL. The role included migration of an on-premise data solution to Azure. Daniel's role also included Data Warehouse (DV2.0) modelling with the Agile Data Engine (ADE) tool. He also developed an Azure Function based data processing framework and Azure infrastructures. Daniel was also tech lead for the Azure infrastructure team.

projects.name: Architecture design
projects.description: Daniel was lead architect for designing a new data platform. Daniel's delivery team consisted of 4 professionals. He was responsible for interviewing business and IT stakeholders and collecting requirements. He was leading workshops to co-design the solution with stakeholders. Finally, he documented the technical solution, mostly based on Azure. The technical solution focused on roadmaps, cloud architecture, integrations, data warehousing and reporting.

projects.name: Data architecture advisory
projects.description: Daniel delivered Data Architecture advisor services to a Finnish industrial company. Daniel interviewed business users of corporate BI solutions, ERP and CRM. Daniel audited the technical architecture, including information security, of an Azure Data Platform based on Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Gen2 and Power BI. Integration to the source systems Netsuite and Salesforce was part of the audit. Finally, he presented recommendations for the roadmap and technical solutions.
